notes.key_messages:
• Candidates found particular difficulty in attempting questions involving aspects of supply and
international exchange rates.
notes.general_comments:
The topics that candidates found most accessible were privatisation, production subsidies, balance of
payments flows and income tax changes. The topics which proved least accessible were movements along
and shifts in the supply curve, elasticity of supply, the consumer price index and exchange rates. Candidates
found questions of a numerical form the most challenging.
